cat > "C:/Users/admin/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--getting-strange/dcee420e-57a4-4172-93df-acc04ee2ce71/scratchpad/unify_camera.py" <<'PYEOF'
import re, pathlib, sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(r"C:\getting_strange")
LEVELS = ROOT / "scripts" / "levels"
SCENES = ROOT / "scenes" / "levels"

STATIONS = ["%02d" % n for n in range(1, 42)] + ["42a", "42b", "42c", "43"]

CANON_DECL = "@onready var camera: CinematicCamera = StationCameraRig.resolve(self)"

CANON_FUNC = """

## PKG-0141 (D-150). Jedna sciezka kamery dla calej kampanii: nazwa wezla,
## granice komory i kolejnosc podpiec zyja w `StationCameraRig`, nie w 45 kopiach.
func _setup_camera() -> void:
\tcamera = StationCameraRig.bind(self, player)
"""

OLD_BODY = """func _setup_camera() -> void:
\tif not is_instance_valid(camera):
\t\tcamera = CinematicCamera.new()
\t\tcamera.name = "Camera"
\t\tadd_child(camera)
\tcamera.target = player
\tcamera.setup_chambers([Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, VIEW_SIZE)])
"""

NEW_BODY = """## PKG-0141 (D-150). Jedna sciezka kamery dla calej kampanii: nazwa wezla,
## granice komory i kolejnosc podpiec zyja w `StationCameraRig`, nie w 45 kopiach.
func _setup_camera() -> void:
\tcamera = StationCameraRig.bind(self, player)
"""

PARK_BLOCK = "\tif camera:\n\t\tcamera.position = Vector2(320.0, 180.0)\n"

decl_re = re.compile(r"^@onready var camera:.*$", re.M)

report = []
for st in STATIONS:
    gd = LEVELS / f"station_{st}.gd"
    src = gd.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    orig = src

    # 1. canonical declaration
    n_decl = len(decl_re.findall(src))
    if n_decl != 1:
        sys.exit(f"station_{st}: expected 1 camera declaration, found {n_decl}")
    src = decl_re.sub(CANON_DECL, src)

    # 2. body
    if OLD_BODY in src:
        src = src.replace(OLD_BODY, NEW_BODY)
        mode = "rewired"
    elif PARK_BLOCK in src:
        assert src.count(PARK_BLOCK) == 1, st
        src = src.replace(PARK_BLOCK, "\t_setup_camera()\n")
        if not src.endswith("\n"):
            src += "\n"
        src = src.rstrip("\n") + "\n" + CANON_FUNC
        mode = "bound"
    else:
        sys.exit(f"station_{st}: no known camera block")

    if src != orig:
        gd.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
    report.append(f"station_{st}: {mode}")

# 3. scenes: unify node name Camera2D -> Camera, ensure target NodePath
for st in STATIONS:
    tscn = SCENES / f"station_{st}.tscn"
    src = tscn.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    orig = src
    src = src.replace(
        '[node name="Camera2D" type="Camera2D" parent="."]',
        '[node name="Camera" type="Camera2D" parent="." node_paths=PackedStringArray("target")]',
    )
    src = src.replace(
        '[node name="Camera" type="Camera2D" parent="."]',
        '[node name="Camera" type="Camera2D" parent="." node_paths=PackedStringArray("target")]',
    )
    # ensure the target assignment follows the camera's script line
    m = re.search(
        r'(\[node name="Camera" type="Camera2D" parent="\." node_paths=PackedStringArray\("target"\)\]\n'
        r'position = Vector2\(320, 180\)\n'
        r'script = ExtResource\("[^"]+"\)\n)',
        src,
    )
    if m is None:
        sys.exit(f"station_{st}.tscn: camera block not in expected shape")
    block = m.group(1)
    tail = src[m.end():]
    if not tail.startswith('target = NodePath("../Player")'):
        src = src[: m.end()] + 'target = NodePath("../Player")\n' + tail
    if src != orig:
        tscn.write_text(src, encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")

print("\n".join(report))
print("scenes unified: %d" % len(STATIONS))
PYEOF
